global.title: Germany invades Poland
global.detail:
Germany invades Poland

The invasion starts the war. Britain and France declare war on Germany two days later.

cells.title: Invasion of France
cells.detail:
Invasion of France

Germany attacks France and the Low Countries, going around the Maginot Line through the Ardennes.

cells.title: France signs armistice
cells.detail:
French armistice

France surrenders and the north and west come under German occupation.

cells.title: Battle of Britain begins
cells.detail:
Battle of Britain

The RAF defends Britain against the German air force, which fails to win control of the skies.

cells.title: Operation Barbarossa
cells.detail:
Operation Barbarossa

Germany invades the Soviet Union, opening the largest front of the war.

cells.title: Pearl Harbor
cells.detail:
Pearl Harbor

Japan attacks the US Pacific Fleet in Hawaii and the United States enters the war.

cells.title: Battle of Midway
cells.detail:
Battle of Midway

The US sinks four Japanese aircraft carriers, a turning point in the Pacific.

cells.title: Battle of Stalingrad begins
cells.detail:
Battle of Stalingrad

German forces reach the Volga and start the brutal fight for the city.

cells.title: Second El Alamein
cells.detail:
Second Battle of El Alamein

British forces under Montgomery defeat Rommel's army and push the Axis out of Egypt.

cells.title: Stalingrad surrender
cells.detail:
Stalingrad surrender

The German Sixth Army surrenders, the first great German defeat.

cells.title: Axis surrenders in Tunisia
cells.detail:
End of the North Africa campaign

About 250,000 Axis troops surrender, clearing the way for the invasion of Italy.

cells.title: D-Day
cells.detail:
D-Day

Allied forces land on the beaches of Normandy, the largest seaborne invasion in history.

cells.title: Battle of Leyte Gulf
cells.detail:
Battle of Leyte Gulf

The largest naval battle of the war cripples what is left of the Japanese fleet.

cells.title: VE Day
cells.detail:
Victory in Europe

Germany's unconditional surrender takes effect, ending the war in Europe.

cells.title: Hiroshima
cells.detail:
Hiroshima

The United States drops an atomic bomb on the city.

cells.title: Nagasaki
cells.detail:
Nagasaki

A second atomic bomb is dropped. The same day the Soviet Union invades Japanese-held Manchuria.

global.title: Japan surrenders
global.detail:
Japan surrenders

The surrender is signed aboard the USS Missouri in Tokyo Bay, ending the Second World War.
